66.title: [P1] Do not execute mutable issue content as trusted AFK instructions
66.body:
<!-- ralph-milestone-finding pr:61 id:422a13f32d983df171ec -->
## Context

**Source:** automated milestone review of PR #61
**Milestone:** Phase 1: Core Profile API (Tracer Bullet)
**Reviewed head:** `aa63f8a3c103ac93e75c485e2b84e4918cf944ac`
**Severity:** P1
**Location:** `scripts/ralph/ralph-loop.mjs:975`

## Finding

Issue bodies are copied verbatim into a workspace-write Codex prompt without validating author association or an approved content hash. An external issue author can edit the body after milestone assignment; generated changes are subsequently validated outside the sandbox, committed, and pushed by a credentialed process. Restrict inputs to trusted authors or immutable approved snapshots, sanitize the child environment, and execute generated validation scripts in a credential-free isolation boundary.

## Definition of done

- Fix the root cause without weakening existing behavior or tests.
- Add or update regression coverage for the failure path.
- Run the relevant checks from AGENTS.md and the Ralph configuration.
- Keep the change focused on this finding; do not create a pull request.

The existing draft PR will be updated and reviewed again after all review findings are resolved.
